All WATER monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. Reduce the Level of all WATER monsters in both players' hands and on the field by 1.

"Rescueroid" + "Ambulanceroid"
This monster cannot be Special Summoned except by Fusion Summon. Once per turn, when a monster on your side of the field is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard, you can Special Summon that monster in Defense Position.

Common.desc: When a "roid" monster is added from your Graveyard to your hand, you can Special Summon that monster.

Common.name: Behold, Gate Guardian!
Common.desc:
Activate this Skill during your Main Phase. Shuffle your entire hand into the Deck, then add 1 Level 11 monster from your Deck to your hand, and if you do, you can Special Summon up to 2 Level 7 monsters with different Attributes from your Deck and/or GY, but their ATK/DEF become 0, also their effects are negated. While you control "Gate Guardian", it gains the following effect.
● Once while face-up on the field, when this card is targeted for an attack: You can change the attacking monster's ATK to 0, until the end of the Damage Step.

Common.name: Believe in your Bro
Common.desc:
Once per turn, you can activate 1 of these Skills based on the face-up monster(s) you control:
● "Elemental HERO": Discard 1 Trap, then add 1 Level 6 or lower Machine "roid" monster from your GY to your hand, then you can destroy 1 monster your opponent controls whose ATK is less than or equal to the added card's.
● Machine "roid": Discard 1 Spell, then Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower Machine "roid" or "Elemental HERO" monster from your Deck in Defense Position, but negate its effects.
 ● Both: Discard 1 card, then Fusion Summon 1 Fusion Monster using only "roid" and "Elemental HERO" monsters you control.
Each of these Skills can only be used once per Duel.

Common.name: Beware the Brothers Paradox!
Common.desc:
Apply the following Skills:
● You can Normal Summon Level 7 monsters for 1 less Tribute.
● You can Tribute Summon 1 Level 7 monster face-up, in addition to your Normal Summon/Set.
● Your opponent takes no effect damage.
● You can only attack with 1 monster each turn, but that monster can make a second attack on monsters during each Battle Phase.

If "Water Dragon" or "Water Dragon Cluster" is sent from the field to your GY while this card is in your GY: Add this card to your hand. Common.name: Bonding - H2O
